name: Cama de plataforma con respaldo
adaptations: Original is pine plywood with oil-wax finish; written as T18 with danish-oil, the closest finish id
Size estimated: 2 plazas read as matrimonial 1350 x 1900; the seller gives no measures
Platform is five loose slotted boards over a frame with a central spine; drawn as the module's narrower slats across the bed, screwed down
Headboard is a flat rounded board standing on two posts above the platform; written as a plain headboard 700 mm from the floor
legs of an estimated 100 mm (the least the module allows) under the frame
notes: Cama matrimonial baja de triplay, sin cajones. En Knotty queda como un bastidor a 30 cm del piso sobre patas ahusadas de 10 cm, en las esquinas y repartidas a lo largo, con tablillas atornilladas a lo ancho que dejan respirar el colchón, y una cabecera lisa de 70 cm que baja hasta el piso. Se arma con pernos, para desarmarla en una mudanza.
